patch_description: This implementation uses a deterministic population-based differential-evolution search directly in barycentric coordinates of the equilateral triangle. Candidate configurations are evaluated in batches over all 165 point triplets, maximizing the minimum normalized triangle area while using a secondary lower-tail objective to avoid configurations with many nearly-degenerate triangles. A final deterministic local refinement phase improves the best discovered arrangement. All candidate points are projected back into the triangle, and the returned coordinates are converted to Cartesian coordinates.
